Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems

Daniel C. Ruiz    Luca Luceri & Emilio Ferrara Affiliation: Information Sciences Institute Affiliation: University of Southern California Affiliation: Los Angeles, CA, USA Email: {dcruiz,lluceri,ferrarae}@isi.edu
Abstract

Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. 1 Introduction

An LLM agent can respect every document’s access permissions and still disclose a conclusion the user is not authorized to receive.
